newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian traffic deaths up 500 percent.
newsitem.headline: Colombian traffic deaths up 500 percent.

text.p: Colombia is heading for a five-fold increase in traffic deaths this year because of excessive speed and drinking, Bogota's El Tiempo newspaper said on Thursday.
It quoted Transportation Minister Jose Rizo as saying at least 2,143 people died in traffic accidents in the first half of the year, compared with about 800 in all of 1996.
Police see drink and speeding as the main causes of the increase and have set up more sobriety checkpoints, the newspaper said.
